name: Serena Williams
hook: Twenty-three Grand Slam singles titles, a Wimbledon record, and the rivalries that defined an era.

facts.label: 23 Grand Slam singles titles
facts.statement: She won 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most in the Open era, including six at Wimbledon and the 2016 title over Angelique Kerber.

facts.label: the French Open
facts.statement: She is a three-time French Open champion, taking the Coupe Suzanne-Lenglen as women's singles winner.

facts.label: Naomi Osaka
facts.statement: Naomi Osaka beat her in the 2018 U.S. Open final for the women's title.

facts.label: Maria Sharapova
facts.statement: Maria Sharapova, then a 17-year-old Siberian-born player, beat her in the 2004 Wimbledon final.

facts.label: the Vanity Fair cover
facts.statement: She appeared nude and pregnant on Vanity Fair's August 2017 cover.

facts.label: MasterClass
facts.statement: She was one of MasterClass's first instructors in 2015, teaching ground strokes, forehands and backhands from the baseline.

facts.label: Richard Williams
facts.statement: Her father Richard Williams coached her and Venus from childhood; Will Smith played him in the film King Richard.
